title: SpatialCLI: Learning to Reason With Spatial Tools, Then Without Them
abstract: arXiv:2607.27703v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in embodied agents to interpret visual inputs, reason about spatial relationships, and make task-level decisions based on that reasoning. However, a fundamental capability mismatch remains: general VLMs can reason about the overall task but often miss the visual details that determine success, while specialist vision models can capture those details but cannot translate them into task-level decisions. In this work, we propose SpatialCLI, a framework that teaches VLMs to reason with spatial tools and progressively internalize the specialist perceptual capabilities they provide. SpatialCLI proceeds in three stages: (1) Call exposes specialist vision models as spatial tools to augment the VLM's perception; (2) Learn uses Cold-Start SFT and agentic RL to improve tool use; and (3) Internalize verbalizes successful tool-use trajectories to internalize specialist perceptual capabilities. translated_title: SpatialCLI：先学会借助空间工具推理，再摆脱工具独立推理
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）越来越多地被应用于具身智能体中，用于解释视觉输入、推理空间关系，并基于这些推理做出任务级决策。然而，一种根本性的能力不匹配依然存在：通用VLM能够对整体任务进行推理，却常常忽略决定任务成败的视觉细节；而专用视觉模型虽然能捕捉这些细节，却无法将它们转化为任务级决策。在本工作中，我们提出了SpatialCLI，这是一个教会VLM借助空间工具进行推理，并逐步内化专用模型所提供的专业感知能力的框架。SpatialCLI分为三个阶段：（1）调用：将专用视觉模型作为空间工具提供给VLM，以增强其感知能力；（2）学习：利用冷启动监督微调（Cold-Start SFT）与智能体强化学习（agentic RL）来提升工具使用能力；（3）内化：将成功的工具使用轨迹进行言语化表达，从而内化专业感知能力。
tldr: 该论文提出SpatialCLI框架，通过“调用—学习—内化”三阶段，让视觉语言模型先将专用视觉模型作为空间工具增强感知，再借助冷启动SFT与智能体强化学习优化工具使用，最终通过轨迹言语化内化专业感知能力，实现无需工具的任务级空间推理。
en_tdlr: SpatialCLI teaches vision-language models to first reason with specialist vision models exposed as spatial tools, then progressively internalize their perceptual capabilities via cold-start SFT, agentic RL, and trajectory verbalization, enabling tool-free task-level spatial reasoning.
